classification: MEASUREMENT-ONLY excerpt of this stage's own 1 kHz capture. No parameter written, no pre-existing record touched.
reason_committed: validation finding I1 (2026-09-13): the full 1 kHz records live only in a session scratchpad and are the sole primary evidence for the published figures. Committed so the result can be audited from raw data after the scratchpad is cleaned.
window_choice: stabilise_start (33.1099 s) .. ladder_end (65.2565 s): strictly contains BOTH the in-flight neutral-stick baseline AND the entire doublet ladder, so every rung and its own in-flight reference are in one file.
figures_rederivable_from_this_file_alone: the entire YAW ladder per-rung table (rudder cmd/actual p2p, max |rate|, rate-pinned duty)
the rudder command-calm census with and without the 1.0 s lead-in
f_y and yaw rate per rung (from imu_accel_ms2 / imu_gyro_rad_s)
the yawing moment N = qbar * S * b * Cn (100 Hz)
the other four surfaces' behaviour during the ladder
timebase_caveat: validation 2026-09-11 finding I15: gz.msgs.Double_V carries no header, so actuator/aero sample times here are RECONSTRUCTED from wall arrival time through the /clock map (monotone piecewise-linear). Only imu_t_sim is a true publisher stamp. The per-topic transport latency DIFFERENCE between /clock and the actuator topic is UNMEASURED. Impact: peak-to-peak, duty and clamp counts are value-based and immune; frequency is essentially immune.
quantization_note: Constant channels are stored EXACTLY as {constant, n}. Varying channels are integer fixed point, value = q * scale, with scale a power of ten chosen so the quantum is <= 1e-4 of that channel's own peak-to-peak over this window (worst case 0.01 % relative). Each channel carries its own scale, quantum_over_channel_p2p and measured worst_case_roundtrip_abs_error so the loss is auditable. IMU and the decimated aero fields are stored as floats ROUNDED TO 9 DECIMAL PLACES - 1e-9 rad/s on a ~0.5 rad/s gyro signal and 1e-9 m/s^2 on a ~22 m/s^2 accelerometer signal, i.e. 7-9 orders below the smallest reported effect, done purely to shorten the committed file.
